candidate.answerReason: Regroup \(43\) as 3 tens and 13 ones. Since \(13-8=5\), \(43-8=35\).

methods.label: Subtract with borrowing
methods.explanation: The 3 in the ones place is too small to subtract 8. After borrowing 1 ten, \(43\) has 3 tens and 13 ones. Since \(13-8=5\), 3 tens and 5 ones remain, so \(43-8=35\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 1 borrowing and subtraction of 8 from a teen number.
